$comment: Committed source of truth for native project configuration.
/ios and /android are generated scaffold and stay gitignored, so anything
hand-edited inside them would be lost on the next `npx cap add`. This file
holds those settings instead; `scripts/cap-configure.mjs` applies them
after every `cap sync` (wired into the cap:sync package scripts).
See CAPACITOR.plan.md Phase 4 for the list of features that depend on these.
iOS Universal Links + Android App Links. Disabled until the domain files
assetlinks.json on arkade.money) AND the Associated Domains capability is
enabled on the Apple app ID — an entitlement for a capability the
provisioning profile lacks fails the iOS build. The custom scheme above
Flip `enabled` to true once both are in place.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Arkade Wallet uses the camera to scan QR codes for addresses, invoices, notes and asset IDs.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Arkade Wallet uses Face ID to unlock your wallet without typing your password.

$comment: minSdkVersion 26 is required by @capacitor/barcode-scanner and is a
Phase 0 decision; the Capacitor template ships 24, so it must be patched.
POST_NOTIFICATIONS is Android 13+ (API 33) and is requested at runtime by
@capacitor/local-notifications, but must still be declared here.
